title: Juicy Tunisian Sausages Tagine
description: A traditional Tunisian one-pot dish featuring juicy sausages, fluffy couscous, and a rich blend of spices. This recipe serves 4-6 people and can be prepared in under an hour.

ingredients.name: Pork Sausages
ingredients.notes: look for Tunisian or merguez-style sausages

instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large clay or ceramic tagine or Dutch oven over medium heat
Add the chopped onion and cook until it starts to soften, about 5 minutes
Add the minced garlic and grated ginger and cook for another minute
Add the cumin, coriander, cayenne pepper, salt, and black pepper and cook for 1 minute
Add the sausages and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes
Add the chicken broth and bring to a boil
Stir in the couscous and cover the tagine or Dutch oven
Simmer over low heat for 15-20 minutes or until the liquid has been absorbed and the couscous is fluffy
Fluff the couscous with a fork and serve hot
Ensure poultry is cooked to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F (juices run clear, no pink remaining) before serving.
